new_today_news.headline: Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program: Extension of 2025 Compliance Reporting Deadline
new_today_news.summary: EPA extends the 2025 RFS compliance reporting deadline from September 1, 2026, to October 1, 2026, to allow obligated parties and small refineries time to adjust compliance strategies following SRE decisions.

recent_news.headline: Cloud Kitchen Market Outlook: Why Ghost Kitchens Are Scaling Fast
recent_news.summary: The cloud kitchen model continues to expand as a structural part of food delivery, with market growth projected from $88.7 billion in 2026 to $203.7 billion by 2033. Operators focusing on platform dependency, brand visibility, and delivery quality are best positioned to capture growth.

backfill_news.headline: Emvolon and Freepoint Commodities Execute Multi-Year Definitive Agreements to Scale High-Value Liquid Fuels
backfill_news.summary: Emvolon, an MIT-spinout converting methane-rich waste gases into high-value liquid fuels, executed definitive commercial agreements with Freepoint Commodities. The transaction establishes Freepoint as anchor off-taker and cornerstone project capital partner for Emvolon's global deployment pipeline, enabling product offtake, global distribution, and capital for individual projects.
